articles.headline: Clarification: sanction targeted Company X Holdings, not Company X Ltd
articles.body: The regulatory action of 17 August applied to the holding entity Company X Holdings; the operating subsidiary Company X Ltd is unaffected by the sanction. Earlier reports did not distinguish the entities.

articles.headline: Downtown fiber cut causes infrastructure outage across business district
articles.body: An infrastructure outage hit the downtown business district after a fiber cut disabled connectivity for thousands of offices for most of the day.
